heroEyebrow: HISTORIC ARMY AIRCRAFT FLIGHT · MIDDLE WALLOP
heroSubtitle: Dedicated to preserving, flying, and sharing the unique living heritage of British Army aviation from our base at the Army Aviation Centre, Middle Wallop.
aboutText: The Historic Army Aircraft Flight (HAAF) operates as a registered charity maintaining and flying a representative collection of historic British Army aircraft. Based at the Army Aviation Centre, Middle Wallop, the Flight keeps these remarkable aircraft where they belong — in the skies, inspiring future generations, honoring veterans, and educating the public on the pivotal role of army aviation from World War II to modern conflicts.
stemText: Through hands-on access to vintage aircraft engineering, airframe maintenance, and piston/turbine technology, HAAF opens its doors to schools, colleges, university engineering societies, and cadet units.
supportText: As an independent registered charity, HAAF relies entirely on the generosity of supporters, donors, and display fees to maintain our historic aircraft in airworthy condition.
